interpretation: About 31% of samples are in emitted code; the VM loop, copies, JIT entry helper, and frame reservation/zeroing account for most remaining samples. This supports investigating call removal and control-flow costs. One short profile is not a performance comparison. The emitted-code mapping was checked against every unknown sampled address.
process_ownership: Only the VM started by this script was inspected. PID, parent, start time, command, working directory, and terminal were revalidated before vmmap and sample.
